clues.text: This town sits in a vale at the foot of a big peak. It lies in the west of its land, in a vale with hills on each side.
clues.narrowing: Puts the player in a mountain-ringed valley in the western Balkans.

source.quote: It is situated in the Sofia Valley at the foot of the Vitosha mountain, in the western part of the country.

clues.text: The cold months here bring snow that falls on the town in drifts. Days stay cold and white, and snow lies on roofs and on the ground.
clues.narrowing: Keeps a high valley capital with snowy winters and warm summers.

source.quote: Winters are relatively cold and snowy.

clues.text: One year past 1878, when rule came back to this land, this town was picked. It was picked as the chief town of the new Third State of the land.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to capitals selected in 1879 for a new state.

source.quote: Sofia was selected as the capital of the Third Bulgarian State in the next year

clues.text: In one part of this town, three great faiths stand side by side. A church, a mosque, and a house of prayer for Jews all stand close by.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: one capital is famed for its triangle of three faiths' temples.

source.quote: This is because three temples of three major world religions—Christianity, Islam and Judaism—are situated close together: Sveta Nedelya Church, Banya Bashi Mosque and Sofia Synagogue.

clues.text: Bulgaria is run from this town, and its work of state is done here. More folk live in this town than in any town in the land.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: capital and largest city of Bulgaria.

source.quote: Sofia is the capital and largest city of Bulgaria.

reveal.blurb: People have lived here since at least 7000 BC, when Romans later called it Serdica. It sits at the foot of the Vitosha mountain, where a church, a mosque and a synagogue stand close together as neighbours. Sofia is the capital of Bulgaria.
